title: Promotion Banner
description:
## Coupon Box (in Buybox)

### <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-0">:person_with_crown:</custom> User story

**As a** shopper on the product detail page, **I want** to clearly see a promotion box in the Buy Box that shows the discount, a brief promotional message, and gives me the option to activate a coupon code, **so that** I can easily take advantage of available deals and apply them during checkout without needing to search for codes manually.

The coupon box will appear within the Buy Box on the product detail page and will include:

* A **promotional icon** (e.g., gift, tag, lightning bolt)
* A **discount percentage** (e.g., "-20%")
* A **text description** (e.g., "Save 20% with this coupon!")
* A **coupon activation button** (e.g., "Apply Coupon")

    * Alternative: a copy code button
    

| **Requirement** | **Description** |  |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Display Logic | It is displayed in the [buybox](https://www.figma.com/design/L5EsT6m0VoOXsqqDHXtCe3/laioutr-SHOP?node-id=98-245816&t=edNTmchAoqmIS03q-4) The box should only display if there is an active promotion/coupon for the product. It must be responsive and adapt to desktop and mobile layouts. | [component](https://www.figma.com/design/L5EsT6m0VoOXsqqDHXtCe3/laioutr-SHOP?node-id=1462-227879&t=edNTmchAoqmIS03q-4)   
 |
| Variants | Variant with Icon choosable icon variant with discount field Derived dynamically from the coupon configuration (e.g., 10%, 15%, 25%). |  |
| Text | Configurable promotional message. Supports localization for international markets. |  |
| Customization | Admins can set: icon, discount %, message, start/end date, Button text Multiple styles supported for different campaigns. <custom data-type="status" data-id="id-1">later</custom>  |  |
| Theming and Colors | Colors are initially managed via theme variables and use global promotion color If these colours are changed by the user, it must be ensured that the colours for texts, icons and also the button variants are also changed (simplest solution): only use colors with shade 9 for background differentiate between **normal colours** and **bright colours** (as defined in the color variables), as shade 9 is set up so that black text conforms to WCAG AA for bright colours and white text conforms to WCAG AA for normal colours. if a bright colour is used:  texts & icon color: always black buttons: black secondary and always black ghost discount bg: always white alpha 8 if a normal color is used: texts & icon color: always white buttons: white secondary and white ghost discount bg: always white alpha 8 example: color is themes / colors / **bright colors** / cyan 9, then use always black variables color is themes / colors / **colors** / soft blue 9, use always white variables | [Theming example with different colours](https://www.figma.com/design/Zle03g3Z7ieN700SDq5j77/Component-Examples?node-id=870-158814&t=0Bc3saTY56wL63ld-4) ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=2352c222-c272-41ea-93c5-a073828e304e&&collection=&height=1518&occurrenceKey=null&width=932&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)  |
| Buttons and Variants | Apply button white or black button, defined by **theme variables** (boolean) only for shop systems that support this function On click: the coupon is "clipped" or stored for the user and visually confirmed via success toast If already activated, show confirmation (e.g., " Applied").  Make sure the user can change the text optional icon left in the button (checkmark) Copy code button white or always black ghost button with icon on the right, defined by **theme variables** (boolean) fallback for all other shop systems/user can choose to not use the apply button On click: copies code to the users clipboard | ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=9aa9cb1a-cce3-45b4-8f78-318529bff7f0&&collection=&height=299&occurrenceKey=null&width=850&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)   |
| Coupon Logic | Upon clicking "Apply Coupon": Coupon is linked to the user's session/cart. Feedback is shown (toast success) with option to navigate to cart | [apply button example](https://www.figma.com/design/Zle03g3Z7ieN700SDq5j77/Component-Examples?node-id=880-493032&t=0Bc3saTY56wL63ld-4) ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=cfc58c43-c69b-47c0-a21e-42749d07eedc&&collection=&height=771&occurrenceKey=null&width=1120&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null) |
| Performance | Should not significantly impact page load; load asynchronously if needed. |  |
| Accessibility | Fully keyboard-navigable and screen-reader friendly. |  |
| A/B Test Ready | Box display should be configurable for testing. |  |
| Analytics | Track impressions, clicks, and activations (event hooks available). |  |

enrichedData.purpose: Enables shoppers to easily discover and apply promotional coupons directly from the product detail page buy box, eliminating the need to manually search for discount codes.
useCases: Display promotion box only when active coupon exists for product
Show promotional icon, discount percentage, and message
Apply coupon to cart with one click and show success confirmation
Copy coupon code to clipboard as alternative activation method
Configure promotional icon from available options
Set discount percentage dynamically from coupon configuration
Customize promotional message with localization support
Schedule promotion with start and end dates
Theme colors automatically based on bright or normal color selection
Track impressions, clicks, and activations via analytics hooks
